title: fix(cloud-connection): an installed package answers its declared hook and action refusals in the caller's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36473
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：装进环境的应用包（包括托管环境里的应用和模块包），在中文用户保存、批量保存或点操作按钮被拦下时，拦截提示改为显示包里自带的中文译文，不再一律显示英文原句；本地直接启动的应用本来就正常，不受影响。
- 为什么做：属于界面体验与多语言专题，替托管环境上的中文业务用户解决「拦截提示全是英文」的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是提示仍显示英文原句，拦截本身照常生效、数据不受影响；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Where the cause was: this repository (objectstack), the package-install composition layer — `packages/cloud-connection` (`MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin.bindArtifactHandlers`).** Not a `main` regression and not the hook refusal catalogue itself.

A hook or action refusal catalogue is translated by `pickTranslatedSentence` (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`) through the `i18n` reader the binder hands the body runner. `bindAppArtifactHandlers` has two callers:

- `AppPlugin.start` (an app booted with `objectstack dev` / `objectstack start`) passes `i18n: hookRefusalI18nReader(ctx)` and `getService`;
- the install door (`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, and the `kernel:ready` rehydrate of every installed package) passed **neither**.

So for every package installed into an environment, `pickTranslatedSentence` met `i18n === undefined` and returned the declared sentence, on every door that runs the hook (`POST /api/v1/batch`, a record update, an action that writes) and for action refusals too. The package's zh-CN pack was loaded into the same `i18n` service by the same plugin (`applySideEffects`), which is why its labels and confirm texts were Chinese on the same pages. The install door's call is byte-identical on the 18.6.0 tag (`@objectstack/runtime@18.6.0`, commit 958ee0359), so the reporter's local 18.6.0 boots translated because they went through `AppPlugin`, not because 18.6.0 differed. The two leads named on the card (the `sourceLocale` label change and the `/batch` `failedOperation` change) do not touch this path.

The fix:

- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: the install-door bind now passes the same `i18n` reader and `getService` that `AppPlugin.start` passes, and says once at `warn` if the runtime it resolves has no reader.
- `packages/runtime/src/index.ts`: exports `hookRefusalI18nReader`, so both doors use the one reader.

Same seam, also fixed by the `getService` half (named here as the bounded in-place fix): an installed package's `ctx.text` now reads the organization's language, and an installed action body's `ctx.email.send` / `ctx.activity.append` reach their services, as a booted app's do.

The refusal body shape, code and status are unchanged. `zh-Hans` reaches a `zh-CN` pack through the existing negotiation (`negotiatedLocale` over `getLocales()`, `resolveLocaleAmong` step 3).

What this PR cannot show: whether the hosted environment installs packages through this install door. That is the in-repo door for "a package installed into an environment", and it reproduces the reported symptom exactly; if the hosted host binds installed packages through a path of its own, that path needs the same two options.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-artifact-handlers.test.ts` (the existing install-local binder harness): a package with a hook refusal catalogue (`reasons` + `params`), a script action with a refusal catalogue, and a zh-CN pack is installed through the real install route and the real `bindAppArtifactHandlers`; the bound hook body and action handler are run with a `zh-Hans` caller and read through `mapDataError`:

- install, hook: status 400, `code` VALIDATION_ERROR, `declaredCode` ORDER_NOT_READY, `userMessage` is the zh-CN reason sentence with its param filled; an `en` caller gets the declared sentence (control);
- install, action: status 409, `declaredCode` NOT_DRAFT, zh-CN sentence; `en` control;
- rehydrate at `kernel:ready`: the same two answers.

The i18n double answers as `FileI18nAdapter` does (exact-locale `t()`, key echoed on a miss), so the `zh-Hans` to `zh-CN` step is the catalogue's own negotiation.

Local readings, ablation (removing the `i18n` option from the install-door bind) and gate results are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #36473; any that the shared verify queue did not reach are marked NOT MEASURED there and are covered by this PR's `Test Core` / `TypeScript Type Check` runs.

## Acceptance notes

- The install door previously also omitted `getService`, so installed bodies never reached email, audit or the organization's language; covered by the same one-line binding fix above.

## Verification

Read first (risk order):
1. `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the `bind(ql, manifest, …)` call: the two options added.
2. `packages/runtime/src/index.ts`: the one new export.
3. The new describe in `marketplace-install-local-artifact-handlers.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-artifact-handlers.test.ts` (after building the package's dependency closure) shows the three new cases green; delete the `i18n:` line in the install-door bind and the hook and action cases fail with the English sentence.
